base.label: Without-freeze same-version model
base.selection: released canonical no-freeze ForecastBench model-version panel

evaluation.design: ten-repeat event-disjoint two-fold cross-fit; all diversity diagnostics and Directional CF weights use the named training fold only

total_variation.formula: mean(abs(p_base - p_partner)) on original paired Bernoulli probabilities
total_variation.label: Total variation (TV)

fold_views.a_to_b: A-train diversity and B-test aggregation outcome
fold_views.b_to_a: B-train diversity and A-test aggregation outcome
fold_views.combined: ten A→B and ten B→A evaluations pooled

best_single.formula: higher test-fold adjusted Brier Index of base and partner on identical support
best_single.label: Best Single

cf_directional.formula: direction-specific clipped C / D weight fitted on the training fold
cf_directional.label: Directional CF

piecewise_odds.formula: threshold-5 piecewise transform of the summed base/partner logits
piecewise_odds.label: Piecewise Odds

partner.label: With-freeze same-version model
partner.selection: every eligible exact zero-shot or scratchpad configuration

provenance.imputation_policy: exclude Polymarket rows backed only by original ForecastBench forecasts marked imputed=true

scope: Each exact zero-shot or scratchpad with-freeze forecast is paired with the same canonical model version without freeze values on identical, non-imputed Polymarket event support.
title: Without-freeze base × with-freeze partner
